You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard. CORE MECHAN FLOW OF THE GAME Daggerheart is a conversation. The GM describes fictional scenarios involving the PCs, and the players take turns describing how their characters react. The goal of every person at the table is to build upon everyone else’s ideas and collaboratively tell a satisfying story. The system facilitates this collaborative process by providing structure to the conversation and mechanics for resolving moments of tension where fate or fortune determine the outcome of events. PLAYER PRINCIPLES & BEST PRACTICES To get the most out of Daggerheart, we recommend players keep the following principles and practices in mind throughout each session: PRINCIPLES • Be a fan of your character and their journey. • Spotlight your friends. • Address the characters and address the players. • Build the world together. • Play to find out what happens. • Hold on gently. BEST PRACTICES • Embrace danger. • Use your resources. • Tell the story. • Discover your character. For more information, see the Daggerheart Core Rulebook, pages 9 and 108. Core Gameplay Loop The core gameplay loop is the procedure that drives every scene, both in and out of combat: STEP 1: SET THE SCENE The GM describes a scenario, establishing the PCs’ surroundings and any dangers, NPCs, or other important details the characters would notice. NICS STEP 2 ASK AND ANSWER QUESTIONS The players ask clarifying questions to explore the scene more deeply and gather information that could inform their characters’ actions. The GM responds to these questions by giving the players information their characters could easily obtain, or by asking questions of their own to the players. The players also respond to any questions the GM poses to them. In this way, the table builds out the fiction collaboratively. STEP 3 BUILD ON THE FICTION t As the scene develops, the players find opportunities to take action—problems to solve, obstacles to overcome, mysteries to investigate, and so on. The players describe how their characters proceed; if their proposed actions carry no chance of failure (or if failure would be boring), they automatically succeed. But if the outcome of their action is unknown, the GM calls for an action roll. Either way, the table works the outcome into the story and moves the fiction forward, narrating how the PC’s actions have changed things. STEP 4 GO BACK TO STEP 1 The process repeats from the beginning, with the GM relaying any updated details or material changes to the players. This process continues until the end of the scene is triggered by a mechanic or arrives organically. The Spotlight The spotlight is a symbol that represents the table’s attention—and therefore the immediate focus of both the narrative and the game mechanics. Any time a character or player becomes the focus of a scene, they “are in the spotlight” or “have the spotlight.” The spotlight moves around the table organically as scenes unfold unless a mechanical trigger determines where the spotlight goes next. For example, when a player fails an action roll, the mechanics prompt the GM to seize the spotlight and make a GM move."}],"srd_reference_text":"Being part of a wildborne community means you lived deep\nwithin the forest. function renderDhList(id,path,keys,labels){const box=$(id);if(!box)return;const arr=getPath(path);box.innerHTML=arr.map((x,i)=>'<div class="repeat-row">'+keys.map((k,j)=>'<label style="grid-column:span '+Math.max(2,Math.floor(11/keys.length))+'">'+h(labels[j])+dyn(path+"."+i+"."+k,x[k],["current","max"].includes(k)?"number":"text")+'</label>').join("")+removeButton(path,i)+'</div>').join("")}
function renderSystem(){
  const tr=$("dhTrackers");if(tr)tr.innerHTML=tracker("Hope (filled = available)","resources.hope",state.resources.hope,state.resources.hopeMax)+tracker("Hit Points (filled = marked)","resources.hpMarked",state.resources.hpMarked,state.resources.hpMax)+tracker("Stress (filled = marked)","resources.stressMarked",state.resources.stressMarked,state.resources.stressMax)+tracker("Armor Slots (filled = marked)","resources.armorMarked",state.resources.armorMarked,state.resources.armorMax)+(state.resources.stressMarked>=state.resources.stressMax?'<p class="bad">All Stress is marked: Vulnerable. You cannot voluntarily pay another Stress cost.</p>':"");
  const ex=$("dhExperiencesList");if(ex)ex.innerHTML=state.experiences.map((x,i)=>'<div class="repeat-row"><label style="grid-column:span 8">Experience'+dyn("experiences."+i+".name",x.name)+'</label><label style="grid-column:span 3">Modifier'+dyn("experiences."+i+".value",x.value,"number",'step="1"')+'</label>'+removeButton("experiences",i)+'</div>').join("");
  const cards=$("dhCardsList");if(cards)cards.innerHTML=state.cards.map((x,i)=>'<div class="list-card">'+removeButton("cards",i)+'<div class="fields"><label class="field"><span>Card</span>'+dyn("cards."+i+".name",x.name)+'</label><label class="field"><span>Domain / level</span>'+dyn("cards."+i+".domain",x.domain)+'</label><label class="field"><span>Location</span>'+dynSelect("cards."+i+".location",x.location,["Loadout","Vault"])+'</label><label class="field"><span>Recall Cost</span>'+dyn("cards."+i+".recall",x.recall,"number",'min="0"')+'</label><label class="field"><span>Used?</span><input data-path="cards.'+i+'.used" type="checkbox" '+(x.used?"checked":"")+'></label><label class="field"><span>Rules / notes</span>'+dyn("cards."+i+".notes",x.notes)+'</label></div><button class="tiny" data-action="dhRecall" data-card="'+i+'">Recall / Vault</button></div>').join("");
  renderDhList("dhWeaponsList","weapons",["name","trait","range","damage","feature"],["Weapon","Trait","Range","Damage","Feature"]);
  renderDhList("dhFeaturesList","features",["name","cost","reset","notes"],["Feature","Cost","Reset","Rules"]);
  renderDhList("dhCountdownsList","countdowns",["name","current","max","trigger"],["Countdown","Current","Maximum","Trigger / consequence"]);
}
function dhGainHope(amount=1){state.resources.hope=clamp(n(state.resources.hope)+amount,0,n(state.resources.hopeMax))}
function dhMarkStress(amount=1){for(let i=0;i<amount;i++){if(state.resources.stressMarked<state.resources.stressMax)state.resources.stressMarked++;else state.resources.hpMarked=clamp(n(state.resources.hpMarked)+1,0,n(state.resources.hpMax))}}
function dhOutcome(success,hope,fear,critical,reaction){
  if(critical)return reaction?"Critical reaction: succeeds and ignores effects that would still apply on a normal success; it does not grant Hope or clear Stress.":"Critical Success: automatic success, gain 1 Hope, clear 1 Stress, and gain an extra benefit or opportunity.";
  if(success&&hope>fear)return"Success with Hope: the action succeeds and you gain 1 Hope.";
  if(success)return"Success with Fear: the action succeeds, but the GM gains Fear and may add a consequence or move as allowed.";
  if(hope>fear)return"Failure with Hope: the action fails or changes, and you gain 1 Hope.";
  return"Failure with Fear: the action fails or changes and the GM gains Fear; expect a consequential GM move."
}
function doDhRoll(){
  const hope=rollDie(12),fear=rollDie(12),critical=hope===fear,reaction=state.roll.reaction===true,trait=n(state.traits[state.roll.trait]),adv=state.roll.advantage?rollDie(6)*Math.sign(n(state.roll.advantage)):0;let exp=0,spent=false;const idx=n(state.roll.experienceIndex);
  if(idx>=0&&state.experiences[idx]){if(state.resources.hope>0){state.resources.hope--;exp=n(state.experiences[idx].value);spent=true}else status("Experience was not added because no Hope was available.","bad")}
  const total=hope+fear+trait+n(state.roll.modifier)+adv+exp,success=critical||total>=n(state.roll.difficulty);
  if(!reaction){if(critical){dhGainHope(1);state.resources.stressMarked=Math.max(0,n(state.resources.stressMarked)-1)}else if(hope>fear)dhGainHope(1)}
  $("hopeDie").textContent=hope;$("fearDie").textContent=fear;lastRoll={hope,fear,total,success,critical};
  $("rollResult").textContent="Hope "+hope+" + Fear "+fear+" + "+state.roll.trait+" "+trait+(adv?" "+(adv>0?"+":"")+adv+" advantage die":"")+(exp?" + "+exp+" Experience":"")+" = "+total+" vs Difficulty "+state.roll.difficulty+"\n"+dhOutcome(success,hope,fear,critical,reaction)+(spent?"\n1 Hope spent to use the Experience.":"");render();scheduleSave()
}
function dhDamageBand(value){if(value<=0)return{severity:"None",hp:0};if(value<state.computed.major)return{severity:"Minor",hp:1};if(value<state.computed.severe)return{severity:"Major",hp:2};return{severity:"Severe",hp:3}}
function applyDhDamage(useArmor=false){
  let value=n(state.damage.incoming);if(state.damage.resistant)value=Math.ceil(value/2);value=Math.max(0,value-n(state.damage.flatReduction));let band=dhDamageBand(value),armorUsed=false;
  if(useArmor&&!state.damage.direct&&band.hp>0&&state.resources.armorMarked<state.resources.armorMax){state.resources.armorMarked++;band={severity:band.hp===3?"Major":band.hp===2?"Minor":"None",hp:Math.max(0,band.hp-1)};armorUsed=true}
  state.resources.hpMarked=clamp(n(state.resources.hpMarked)+band.hp,0,n(state.resources.hpMax));lastRoll={type:"damage",value,band,direct:state.damage.direct};
  $("damageResult").textContent="Final damage "+value+" vs Major "+state.computed.major+" / Severe "+state.computed.severe+"\n"+(armorUsed?"Marked 1 Armor Slot; severity reduced one step.\n":"")+band.severity+" damage → mark "+band.hp+" HP."+(state.resources.hpMarked>=state.resources.hpMax?"\nLAST HP MARKED: the character falls and immediately chooses a Death Move.":"");render();scheduleSave()
}
function doDhRest(longRest){
  if(!longRest&&state.resources.shortRests>=3){status("After three consecutive short rests, the next rest must be long.","bad");return}
  for(let pick=0;pick<2;pick++){const c=prompt((longRest?"Long":"Short")+" Rest — downtime move "+(pick+1)+" of 2:\nheal, stress, armor, or prepare","stress");if(!c)continue;const amount=longRest?999:rollDie(4)+state.computed.tier;if(c.toLowerCase().startsWith("heal"))state.resources.hpMarked=Math.max(0,state.resources.hpMarked-(longRest?state.resources.hpMarked:amount));else if(c.toLowerCase().startsWith("stress"))state.resources.stressMarked=Math.max(0,state.resources.stressMarked-(longRest?state.resources.stressMarked:amount));else if(c.toLowerCase().startsWith("armor"))state.resources.armorMarked=Math.max(0,state.resources.armorMarked-(longRest?state.resources.armorMarked:amount))}
  if(longRest)state.resources.shortRests=0;else state.resources.shortRests++;render();scheduleSave();status((longRest?"Long":"Short")+" Rest moves applied. The GM handles Fear and countdown consequences.","ok")
}
function systemAction(a,b){
  if(a==="dhRoll")doDhRoll();else if(a==="addDhExperience")add("experiences",{name:"",value:2});else if(a==="addDhCard")add("cards",{name:"",domain:"",location:"Loadout",recall:0,used:false,notes:""});
  else if(a==="addDhWeapon")add("weapons",{name:"",trait:"",range:"",damage:"",feature:""});else if(a==="addDhFeature")add("features",{name:"",cost:"",reset:"",notes:""});else if(a==="addDhCountdown")add("countdowns",{name:"",current:0,max:4,trigger:""});
  else if(a==="dhMarkStress"){dhMarkStress(1);render();scheduleSave()}else if(a==="dhDamage")applyDhDamage(false);else if(a==="dhArmor")applyDhDamage(true);
  else if(a==="dhShortRest")doDhRest(false);else if(a==="dhLongRest")doDhRest(true);
  else if(a==="dhHelp")$("rollResult").textContent="HELP AN ALLY\nDescribe how you help and spend 1 Hope when the rule calls for it. Roll the appropriate advantage die and give it to the ally's action roll; follow the exact feature or table procedure for any extra costs.";
  else if(a==="dhTagTeam")$("rollResult").textContent="TAG TEAM ROLL\nSpend the required Hope, describe how both heroes act together, choose who rolls, combine the permitted traits/Experiences, and let both players shape the outcome. Use the exact core procedure for Hope/Fear and spotlight effects.";
  else if(a==="dhDeath")$("damageResult").textContent="CHOOSE A DEATH MOVE IMMEDIATELY\n• Blaze of Glory: embrace death and make one final decisive action.\n• Avoid Death: fall unconscious; make the Hope Die scar check and awaken after healing or a long rest.\n• Risk It All: roll Hope and Fear with no modifiers; the dice decide whether you recover, die, or clear resources. Read the exact move before rolling.";
  else if(a==="dhRecall"){const i=n(b.dataset.card),card=state.cards[i];if(!card)return;if(card.location==="Vault"){if(state.resources.stressMarked+n(card.recall)>state.resources.stressMax){status("Not enough open Stress slots to pay Recall Cost.","bad");return}dhMarkStress(n(card.recall));card.location="Loadout"}else card.location="Vault";render();scheduleSave()}
}
function systemSetup(){document.body.addEventListener("change",e=>{if(!e.target.dataset.track)return;const path=e.target.dataset.track,index=n(e.target.dataset.trackIndex);setPath(path,e.target.checked?index+1:index);render();scheduleSave()})}

init();
</script>

<script id="characterSheetCustomizationScript">

  'style-5':{primary:'#6d858e',secondary:'#a6bec5',surface:'#f7f7f7',text:'#11161b',background:'#11161b'},
  'style-6':{primary:'#c97a00',secondary:'#357c8f',surface:'#fff9df',text:'#292112',background:'#18272c'}
};
const DEFAULT_COLORS={primary:'#2f5ea8',secondary:'#c9912f',surface:'#fff8e8',text:'#171a20',background:'#101827'};
const KEY='character-sheet-appearance-v2:'+(location.pathname.split('/').pop()||document.title);
const root=document.documentElement;
const byId=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const bubble=byId('characterSheetBubble');
const toggle=byId('characterSheetBubbleToggle');
const panel=byId('characterSheetBubblePanel');
const feedback=byId('csFeedback');
let state={preset:'default',colors:null,backgroundMode:'default',backgroundImage:'',backgroundUrl:'',overlay:46,position:null};
let suppressClick=false;

function announce(message){feedback.textContent=message;clearTimeout(announce.timer);announce.timer=setTimeout(()=>{if(feedback.textContent===message)feedback.textContent='';},3500)}
function load(){try{const embedded=window.__EMBEDDED_CHARACTER_SHEET_APPEARANCE__;if(embedded&&typeof embedded==='object')state=Object.assign(state,embedded);else{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null');if(saved&&typeof saved==='object')state=Object.assign(state,saved);}}catch(_){}}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state));}catch(_){announce('This image is too large to save locally, but it remains active for this session.')}}
function setVar(name,value){root.style.setProperty(name,value)}
function activeColors(){return state.colors||PRESETS[state.preset]||DEFAULT_COLORS}
function applyColors(){
  const enabled=state.preset!=='default'||!!state.colors;
  if(!enabled){root.removeAttribute('data-cs-style');['--cs-primary','--cs-secondary','--cs-surface','--cs-text','--cs-background'].forEach(v=>root.style.removeProperty(v));return;}
  const c=activeColors();root.setAttribute('data-cs-style','active');
  setVar('--cs-primary',c.primary);setVar('--cs-secondary',c.secondary);setVar('--cs-surface',c.surface);setVar('--cs-text',c.text);setVar('--cs-background',c.background);
}
function cssUrl(value){return 'url('+JSON.stringify(value)+')'}
function applyBackground(){
  root.style.setProperty('--cs-overlay',String(Math.max(0,Math.min(85,Number(state.overlay)||0))/100));
  root.removeAttribute('data-cs-background');
  if(state.backgroundMode==='custom'&&state.backgroundImage){root.setAttribute('data-cs-background','custom');root.style.setProperty('--cs-background-image',cssUrl(state.backgroundImage));}
  else if(state.backgroundMode==='none'){root.setAttribute('data-cs-background','none');root.style.removeProperty('--cs-background-image');}

}

  byId('csBackgroundUrl').value=state.backgroundUrl||'';byId('csOverlayRange').value=state.overlay;byId('csOverlayValue').textContent=state.overlay+'%';
}

function sectionLabel(el,index){const heading=el.querySelector(':scope > header h1,:scope > header h2,:scope > header h3,:scope > .module-hd h1,:scope > .module-hd h2,:scope > .module-hd h3,h1,h2,h3');return (heading&&heading.textContent.trim())||el.getAttribute('aria-label')||('Section '+index)}
function buildJumpList(){
  const select=byId('csJumpSelect');const found=[];const seen=new Set();
  const candidates=document.querySelectorAll('main section[id],main .module[id],.layout .module[id],.sheet .panel[id],.sheet section[id]');
  candidates.forEach((el,i)=>{if(!seen.has(el.id)){seen.add(el.id);found.push({id:el.id,label:sectionLabel(el,i+1)})}});

}
function jump(){const value=byId('csJumpSelect').value;if(value==='__top')scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});else if(value==='__bottom')scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'});else{const target=byId(value);if(target)target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});}closePanel()}
function openPanel(){bubble.classList.add('open');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');positionPanel()}

function readColors(){return{primary:byId('csPrimaryColor').value,secondary:byId('csSecondaryColor').value,surface:byId('csSurfaceColor').value,text:byId('csTextColor').value,background:byId('csBackgroundColor').value}}

function processImage(file){
  if(!file||!file.type.startsWith('image/'))return announce('Choose an image file.');
  const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>{const image=new Image();image.onload=()=>{const max=2200,scale=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(image.naturalWidth,image.naturalHeight));const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.naturalWidth*scale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(image.naturalHeight*scale));canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);const type=file.type==='image/png'?'image/png':'image/jpeg';state.backgroundImage=canvas.toDataURL(type,type==='image/jpeg'?.88:undefined);state.backgroundUrl='';state.backgroundMode='custom';applyBackground();syncControls();save();announce('Background image applied.');};image.onerror=()=>announce('The image could not be read.');image.src=reader.result;};reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function currencyFieldsMarkup(){const field=(key,label,step='1')=>`<label>${label}<input data-currency-key="${key}" type="number" step="${step}"></label>`;switch(CFG.currency){case'dnd-coins':return field('cp','Copper (cp)')+field('sp','Silver (sp)')+field('ep','Electrum (ep)')+field('gp','Gold (gp)')+field('pp','Platinum (pp)');case'pf2e-coins':return field('cp','Copper (cp)')+field('sp','Silver (sp)')+field('gp','Gold (gp)')+field('pp','Platinum (pp)');case'daggerheart-gold':return field('coin','Coins')+field('handful','Handfuls')+field('bag','Bags')+field('chest','Chests');case'bitd-coin':return field('coin','Carried Coin')+field('stash','Stash')+field('crewCoin','Crew Coin');case'coc-finance':return field('cash','Cash','.01')+field('assets','Assets','.01')+field('spending','Spending Level','.01');case'fate-abstract':return field('balance','Optional Story Funds','.01')+`<label>Unit<input id="hyperCurrencyUnit" type="text"></label>`;default:return field('balance','Balance','.01')+`<label>Unit<input id="hyperCurrencyUnit" type="text"></label>`}}
function currencyDenoms(){switch(CFG.currency){case'dnd-coins':return[['cp','cp'],['sp','sp'],['ep','ep'],['gp','gp'],['pp','pp']];case'pf2e-coins':return[['cp','cp'],['sp','sp'],['gp','gp'],['pp','pp']];case'daggerheart-gold':return[['coin','coin'],['handful','handful'],['bag','bag'],['chest','chest']];case'bitd-coin':return[['coin','coin'],['stash','stash'],['crewCoin','crew coin']];case'coc-finance':return[['cash','cash']];default:return[['balance','unit']]}}

function buildModal(){if($('hyperProgressModal'))return;const m=document.createElement('div');m.className='hyper-modal';m.id='hyperProgressModal';m.setAttribute('role','dialog');m.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');m.innerHTML=`<div class="hyper-modal-card"><header><h2 id="hyperModalTitle">Progression Ready</h2><button id="hyperModalClose" class="secondary" type="button">Close</button></header><div class="modal-body" id="hyperModalBody"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button id="hyperModalCancel" class="secondary" type="button">Not Yet</button><button id="hyperModalApply" type="button">Apply Progression</button></div></div>`;document.body.append(m);$('hyperModalClose').addEventListener('click',closeModal);$('hyperModalCancel').addEventListener('click',closeModal);m.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===m)closeModal()});$('hyperModalApply').addEventListener('click',applyProgression)}
function openModal(title,body,key='',force=false){const a=auto();if(!force&&key&&a.progression.lastPopupKey===key)return;a.progression.lastPopupKey=key||a.progression.lastPopupKey;$('hyperModalTitle').textContent=title;$('hyperModalBody').innerHTML=body;$('hyperProgressModal').classList.add('open');schedule()}
function closeModal(){$('hyperProgressModal')?.classList.remove('open')}
function history(type,amount,memo,extra={}){const e={at:now(),type,amount,memo:memo||'',...extra};if(type==='currency')auto().currency.history.unshift(e);else auto().progression.history.unshift(e);return e}
const DND_XP=[0,300,900,2700,6500,14000,23000,34000,48000,64000,85000,100000,120000,140000,165000,195000,225000,265000,305000,355000];
function totalLevel(){try{return typeof window.totalLevel==='function'?window.totalLevel():stateRef().classes?.reduce((n,c)=>n+number(c.level),0)||0}catch(_){return stateRef().classes?.reduce((n,c)=>n+number(c.level),0)||0}}
function swadeRank(n){return n>=16?'Legendary':n>=12?'Heroic':n>=8?'Veteran':n>=4?'Seasoned':'Novice'}
function fateResources(){return number(stateRef().skills?.find(x=>x.name==='Resources')?.rating)}
function cocCredit(){return number(stateRef().skills?.find(x=>x.name==='Credit Rating')?.value)}
function cocBand(v){return v<=0?'Penniless':v<=9?'Poor':v<=49?'Average':v<=89?'Wealthy':v<=98?'Rich':'Super rich'}
function bitdTrackInfo(){const s=stateRef(),t=$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'playbook',threshold=t==='playbook'?8:t==='crew'?10:6,current=t==='crew'?number(s.crew?.crewXp):number(s.xp?.[t]);return{t,threshold,current}}
function progressionInfo(){const s=stateRef(),a=auto();switch(CFG.progression){case'dnd-xp':{const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),xp=number(s.profile?.xp),next=l>=20?null:DND_XP[l];return{current:xp,next:next===null?'Maximum level':Math.max(0,next-xp)+' XP',status:next!==null&&xp>=next?'Level ready':'Level '+l,prompt:next===null?'Level 20 reached.':`Standard threshold for level ${l+1}: ${next.toLocaleString()} cumulative XP.`}}case'pf2e-xp':{const xp=number(a.progression.xp);return{current:xp+' XP',next:Math.max(0,1000-xp)+' XP',status:xp>=1000?'Level ready':'Level '+number(s.profile?.level),prompt:'Pathfinder uses 1,000 XP per level; excess XP carries over.'}}case'pbta-xp':{const cur=number(s.xp?.current),max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp?.max)||5);return{current:`${cur}/${max}`,next:Math.max(0,max-cur)+' marks',status:cur>=max?'Advance ready':'Tracking',prompt:'The exact playbook defines what an advance can buy. The sheet never invents a universal PbtA level system.'}}case'swade-advances':{const n=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0),rank=swadeRank(n),next=n<4?4:n<8?8:n<12?12:n<16?16:null;return{current:n+' Advances',next:next?`${next-n} to ${swadeRank(next)}`:'Legendary',status:rank,prompt:'Each recorded Advance automatically recalculates Rank and opens the improvement checklist.'}}case'bitd-xp':{const x=bitdTrackInfo();return{current:`${x.current}/${x.threshold}`,next:Math.max(0,x.threshold-x.current)+' XP',status:x.current>=x.threshold?'Advance ready':x.t,prompt:'Playbook fills at 8; Insight, Prowess, and Resolve at 6; crew XP fills at 10.'}}case'narrative-levels':{const lvl=number(s.profile?.level)||1,ss=number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel),target=Math.max(1,number(a.progression.sessionsPerLevel)||3);return{current:`Level ${lvl}`,next:lvl>=10?'Maximum level':`${Math.max(0,target-ss)} session(s)`,status:ss>=target&&lvl<10?'Milestone suggested':`Tier ${lvl===1?1:lvl<=4?2:lvl<=7?3:4}`,prompt:'The party levels together when the Guide declares a narrative milestone, commonly around every three sessions.'}}case'character-points':{const earned=number(a.progression.earned),spent=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsSpent),budget=number(s.budget);const available=budget+earned-spent;return{current:`${available} available`,next:`${earned} earned`,status:available<0?'Overspent':'Balanced',prompt:`Starting budget ${budget}; earned ${earned}; calculated spent ${spent}; available ${available}.`}}case'development':{const checked=(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos');return{current:checked.length+' checked',next:checked.length?'Development phase':'Use skills',status:cocBand(cocCredit()),prompt:`Credit Rating ${cocCredit()} is ${cocBand(cocCredit())}. Checked skills are resolved with externally supplied d100 and d10 results.`}}case'milestones':{const m=a.progression.milestones,total=number(m.minor)+number(m.significant)+number(m.major);return{current:total+' awarded',next:'Story-driven',status:`Resources ${fateResources()}`,prompt:'Minor, significant, and major milestones change the character according to the fiction; Fate Core does not use XP levels.'}}default:return{current:'—',next:'—',status:'Ready',prompt:''}}
}

workflow.</p><ul><li>Choose the class receiving the level.</li><li>Apply Hit Die / HP growth, proficiency changes, class features, subclass features, spell slots, prepared/known limits, and tracked features.</li></ul>`;case'pf2e-xp':return `<p>Advance from level ${number(s.profile?.level)} to ${Math.min(20,number(s.profile?.level)+1)} and carry excess XP.</p><ul><li>Increase level-based feat and ability-boost schedule.</li><li>Update spell ranks, slots, equipment expectations, and retraining choices.</li></ul>`;case'pbta-xp':return `<p>The XP track is full.</p><ul><li>Choose an improvement from the exact game and playbook.</li><li>Record any stat increase, new move, cross-playbook move, relationship change, retirement, or playbook change.</li><li>The sheet subtracts one full XP track and preserves carryover.</li></ul>`;case'swade-advances':return `<p>Record one SWADE Advance.</p><ul><li>Gain an eligible Edge; or increase one skill at/above its linked Attribute one die type.</li><li>Increase two skills below linked Attributes; or buy a new skill at d4.</li><li>Increase one Attribute when allowed for the current Rank.</li><li>Check Rank, Trait, setting, ancestry, and Arcane Background prerequisites.</li></ul>`;case'bitd-xp':{const x=bitdTrackInfo();return `<p>${html(x.t)} XP is full.</p><ul><li>${x.t==='playbook'?'Choose a new special ability.':x.t==='crew'?'Choose one crew special ability or mark two crew upgrade boxes.':'Add one action dot under '+html(x.t)+'.'}</li><li>Subtract one full track and preserve overflow.</li><li>Record the choice in the appropriate ability, action, or crew area.</li></ul>`}case'narrative-levels':{const n=Math.min(10,number(s.profile?.level)+1);return `<p>Advance the party to Daggerheart level ${n}.</p><ul><li>Choose two valid advancement slots.</li><li>Increase Major and Severe damage thresholds by 1.</li><li>Gain one legal domain card at or below the new level.</li>${[2,5,8].includes(n)?'<li>Tier achievement: gain a +2 Experience and increase Proficiency by 1.</li>':''}<li>Recalculate Evasion, HP, Stress, Proficiency, thresholds, and card loadout.</li></ul>`}case'character-points':return `<p>Spend earned character points only when training, story, and campaign permissions support the change.</p><ul><li>Improve or learn skills.</li><li>Raise attributes or secondary characteristics with approval.</li><li>Buy new advantages or buy off disadvantages when justified.</li><li>The point ledger automatically recalculates spent and available points.</li></ul>`;case'development':return `<p>Resolve checked skills using d100 results supplied by the table or future portal.</p><ul><li>If the d100 result is above the current skill, add the supplied d10 improvement.</li><li>If the result is equal to or below the skill, no increase occurs.</li><li>Erase the check after resolving it.</li><li>Cthulhu Mythos does not use ordinary improvement checks.</li></ul><div class="hyper-manual-roll"><label>Improvement check d100 result <input id="cocImproveRoll" type="number" min="1" max="100" value="50"></label><label>Improvement d10 result <input id="cocImproveGain" type="number" min="1" max="10" value="5"></label></div>`;case'milestones':{const t=$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'minor';const rows={minor:['Switch two skill ratings.','Replace one Average skill.','Replace a stunt.','Rename a non-high-concept aspect.','Clear stress and begin consequence recovery as fiction allows.'],significant:['Gain one skill point while preserving a valid skill column.','Also receive the benefits of a minor milestone.'],major:['Gain one Refresh.','Advance a skill beyond the current cap if the campaign allows.','Rename the high concept if the story supports it.','Recover the ability to take an extreme consequence after rewriting it.','Also receive significant and minor milestone benefits.']}[t];return `<p>Apply a ${html(t)} milestone.</p><ul>${rows.map(x=>'<li>'+html(x)+'</li>').join('')}</ul>`}default:return'<p>Record the advancement in the system-specific sections.</p>'}}
function recordProgress(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef(),amount=Math.max(0,number($('hyperProgressAmount')?.value||1)),memo=$('hyperProgressMemo')?.value||'';if(CFG.progression==='development'){openModal('Call of Cthulhu Development Phase',advancementChecklist(),'coc-development-'+(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked).map(x=>x.name).join('|'),true);return}if(CFG.progression==='milestones'){const t=$('hyperProgressTarget').value;a.progression.milestones[t]=number(a.progression.milestones[t])+Math.max(1,amount);history('progression',Math.max(1,amount),memo,{target:t});if(s.advancement)s.advancement.milestone=t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1);openModal(`${t[0].toUpperCase()+t.slice(1)} Milestone`,advancementChecklist(),`fate-${t}-${a.progression.milestones[t]}`,true)}else if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){s.profile.xp=number(s.profile.xp)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'xp'})}else if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'){a.progression.xp=number(a.progression.xp)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'xp'})}else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'){s.xp.current=number(s.xp.current)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'xp'})}else if(CFG.progression==='swade-advances'){const count=Math.max(1,Math.floor(amount));a.progression.advances=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0)+count;for(let i=0;i<count;i++)s.advances.push({name:`Advance ${s.advances.length+1}`,rank:swadeRank(a.progression.advances),type:'',notes:memo});s.profile.rank=swadeRank(a.progression.advances);history('progression',count,memo,{target:'advance'});openModal('SWADE Advance Recorded',advancementChecklist(),`swade-${a.progression.advances}`,true)}else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.t==='crew')s.crew.crewXp=number(s.crew.crewXp)+amount;else s.xp[x.t]=number(s.xp[x.t])+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:x.t})}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel=number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'sessions'})}else if(CFG.progression==='character-points'){a.progression.earned=number(a.progression.earned)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'character-points'})}rerender();checkProgression(true)}
function applyProgression(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef();if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){$('levelUpBtn')?.click();closeModal();return}if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'){if(number(a.progression.xp)<1000||number(s.profile.level)>=20)return;const old=number(s.profile.level);a.progression.xp-=1000;s.profile.level=old+1;history('progression',1,`Advanced to level ${s.profile.level}`,{target:'level'});if(s.hp){const gain=number(s.hp.classPerLevel)+number(s.attributes?.con);s.hp.current=number(s.hp.current)+Math.max(1,gain)}a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'){const max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp.max)||5);if(number(s.xp.current)<max)return;s.xp.current-=max;s.advancements=s.advancements||[];s.advancements.push({name:'Choose exact-game advancement',notes:'XP track completed '+new Date().toLocaleDateString()});history('progression',1,'XP track converted to an advancement',{target:'advance'});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.current<x.threshold)return;if(x.t==='crew')s.crew.crewXp-=x.threshold;else s.xp[x.t]-=x.threshold;history('progression',1,`${x.t} track converted to an advance`,{target:x.t});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){const lvl=number(s.profile.level);if(lvl>=10)return;const next=lvl+1;s.profile.level=next;s.thresholds.majorMod=number(s.thresholds.majorMod)+1;s.thresholds.severeMod=number(s.thresholds.severeMod)+1;if([2,5,8].includes(next)){s.resources.proficiency=number(s.resources.proficiency)+1;s.experiences=s.experiences||[];s.experiences.push({name:'New Tier Experience',value:2})}a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel=0;history('progression',1,`Advanced to Daggerheart level ${next}`,{target:'level'});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='development'){const skillName=$('cocDevelopmentSkill')?.value,skill=(s.skills||[]).find(x=>x.name===skillName);if(!skill)return;const roll=clamp(number($('cocImproveRoll')?.value),1,100),gain=clamp(number($('cocImproveGain')?.value),1,10),old=number(skill.value),success=roll>old;if(success)skill.value=clamp(old+gain,0,99);skill.checked=false;history('progression',success?gain:0,`${skill.name}: d100 ${roll} vs ${old}${success?`, +${gain}`:', no increase'}`,{target:skill.name,roll,gain,success});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='milestones'){history('progression',0,'Milestone checklist acknowledged',{target:$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'minor'})}else if(CFG.progression==='character-points'){history('progression',0,'Character point spending checklist reviewed',{target:'character-points'})}closeModal();rerender();checkProgression(false)}
function checkProgression(force=false){const s=stateRef(),a=auto();if(!$('hyperProgressModal'))return;if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),next=l>=20?Infinity:DND_XP[l];if(number(s.profile?.xp)>=next)openModal(`Level ${l+1} Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`dnd-${l+1}-${number(s.profile.xp)}`,force)}else if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'&&number(a.progression.xp)>=1000&&number(s.profile.level)<20)openModal(`Pathfinder Level ${number(s.profile.level)+1} Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`pf-${number(s.profile.level)+1}-${Math.floor(number(a.progression.xp)/1000)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'&&number(s.xp.current)>=Math.max(1,number(s.xp.max)))openModal('PbtA Advancement Ready',advancementChecklist(),`pbta-${number(s.xp.current)}-${number(s.xp.max)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.current>=x.threshold)openModal(`${x.t[0].toUpperCase()+x.t.slice(1)} Advance Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`bitd-${x.t}-${x.current}`,force)}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'&&number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)>=Math.max(1,number(a.progression.sessionsPerLevel))&&number(s.profile.level)<10)openModal(`Daggerheart Level ${number(s.profile.level)+1} Suggested`,advancementChecklist(),`dh-${number(s.profile.level)+1}-${number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='development'&&(s.skills||[]).some(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos')&&force)openModal('Development Phase Ready',advancementChecklist(),`coc-${(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked).length}`,force)}
function wallet(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef(),w=a.currency.wallet;if(CFG.currency==='dnd-coins')return s.coins||(s.coins={cp:0,sp:0,ep:0,gp:0,pp:0});if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin')return{get coin(){return number(s.resources.coin)},set coin(v){s.resources.coin=v},get stash(){return number(s.resources.stash)},set stash(v){s.resources.stash=v},get crewCoin(){return number(s.crew.coin)},set crewCoin(v){s.crew.coin=v}};return w}
function ratios(){switch(CFG.currency){case'dnd-coins':return{cp:1,sp:10,ep:50,gp:100,pp:1000};case'pf2e-coins':return{cp:1,sp:10,gp:100,pp:1000};case'daggerheart-gold':return{coin:1,handful:10,bag:100,chest:1000};default:return null}}
function currencyUnit(){return $('hyperCurrencyUnit')?.value||auto().currency.unit||({'dnd-coins':'cp','pf2e-coins':'cp','daggerheart-gold':'coin','bitd-coin':'coin','coc-finance':'cash','fate-abstract':'story funds'})[CFG.currency]||'unit'}
function currencyTotal(){const w=wallet(),r=ratios();if(r){const total=Object.entries(r).reduce((n,[k,m])=>n+number(w[k])*m,0);if(CFG.currency==='dnd-coins')return`${total.toLocaleString()} cp equivalent · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} gp`;if(CFG.currency==='pf2e-coins')return`${total.toLocaleString()} cp equivalent · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} gp`;return`${total.toLocaleString()} coins · ${(total/10).toFixed(1)} handfuls · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} bags · ${(total/1000).toFixed(3)} chests`}if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin')return`${number(w.coin)} carried coin · ${number(w.stash)} stash · ${number(w.crewCoin)} crew coin`;if(CFG.currency==='coc-finance')return`Cash ${number(w.cash).toLocaleString()} · Assets ${number(w.assets).toLocaleString()} · Spending ${number(w.spending).toLocaleString()} · Credit ${cocCredit()} (${cocBand(cocCredit())})`;if(CFG.currency==='fate-abstract')return`Resources ${fateResources()} · ${number(w.balance).toLocaleString()} ${currencyUnit()} (optional exact funds)`;return`${number(w.balance).toLocaleString()} ${currencyUnit()}`}
function syncCurrencyInputs(){const w=wallet();qa('[data-currency-key]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.currencyKey;el.value=number(w[k])});if($('hyperCurrencyUnit'))$('hyperCurrencyUnit').value=auto().currency.unit}
function currencyTransaction(sign){const w=wallet(),key=$('hyperCurrencyDenom').value,amount=Math.max(0,number($('hyperCurrencyAmount').value)),delta=sign*amount,memo=$('hyperCurrencyMemo').value;if(sign<0&&number(w[key])<amount){openModal('Insufficient Currency',`<p>The ${html(key)} balance is ${number(w[key])}; this transaction needs ${amount}.</p>`,'',true);return}w[key]=number(w[key])+delta;history('currency',delta,memo,{denomination:key});schedule();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();runAudit()}
function normalizeCurrency(){const w=wallet(),r=ratios();if(!r){if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin'){openModal('Blades Coin & Stash',`<ul><li>Deposit: 1 coin becomes 1 stash.</li><li>Withdrawal: spend 2 stash to gain 1 coin.</li><li>Carried coin above 4 normally consumes load or must be stored.</li></ul>`,'',true)}return}let total=Math.round(Object.entries(r).reduce((n,[k,m])=>n+number(w[k])*m,0));Object.entries(r).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).forEach(([k,m])=>{w[k]=Math.floor(total/m);total%=m});history('currency',0,'Normalized denominations',{denomination:'all'});schedule();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();runAudit()}

function runAudit(){const s=stateRef(),a=auto(),items=[];const good=t=>items.push({kind:'good',text:t}),warn=t=>items.push({kind:'warn',text:t});switch(CFG.id){case'fate-core':{const refresh=number(s.computed?.outputs?.fateRefresh),fp=number(s.fatePoints);refresh<1?warn('Refresh is below the normal minimum of 1.'):good(`Refresh ${refresh}; Fate points ${fp}.`);s.computed?.pyramidValid?good('Skill pyramid/column validation passes.'):warn('Skill pyramid/column validation needs attention.');break}case'gurps-4e':{const spent=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsSpent),available=number(s.budget)+number(a.progression.earned)-spent;available<0?warn(`Point budget overspent by ${Math.abs(available)}.`):good(`${available} character points available.`);number(s.combat?.hpCurrent)<=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsHP)/3&&warn('Current HP is at or below one-third; apply injury and movement rules.');break}case'coc-7e':{good(`Credit Rating ${cocCredit()}: ${cocBand(cocCredit())}.`);const checked=(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos').length;checked?warn(`${checked} skill improvement check(s) are ready.`):good('No unresolved skill improvement checks.');number(s.resources?.sanCurrent)<number(s.resources?.sanLossStart)-Math.floor(number(s.resources?.sanLossStart)/5)&&warn('Session SAN loss may have reached the indefinite-insanity threshold.');break}case'daggerheart':{const r=s.resources||{};number(r.hope)>number(r.hopeMax)?warn('Hope exceeds maximum.'):good(`Hope ${number(r.hope)}/${number(r.hopeMax)}.`);number(r.hpMarked)>number(r.hpMax)&&warn('Marked HP exceeds available HP slots.');number(r.stressMarked)>number(r.stressMax)&&warn('Marked Stress exceeds available Stress slots.');number(wallet().chest)>1&&warn('More than one chest is marked as carried.');break}case'pathfinder-2e-remastered':{number(a.progression.xp)>=1000?warn('At least one level is ready to apply.'):good(`${number(a.progression.xp)} / 1000 XP.`);number(s.dying)>=4?warn('Dying value is at the normal death threshold.'):good(`Dying ${number(s.dying)}, Wounded ${number(s.wounded)}, Doomed ${number(s.doomed)}.`);break}case'pbta-adapter':{const max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp?.max));number(s.xp?.current)>=max?warn('XP track is full.'):good(`XP ${number(s.xp?.current)}/${max}.`);number(s.harm?.current)>=number(s.harm?.max)&&warn('Harm/condition track is full.');break}case'swade':{const n=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0),rank=swadeRank(n);s.profile.rank!==rank?warn(`Rank should be ${rank} from ${n} Advances.`):good(`${n} Advances: ${rank}.`);number(s.resources?.wounds)>=3&&warn('Three Wounds marked; check Incapacitation procedure.');break}case'blades-in-the-dark':{number(s.resources?.coin)>4?warn('More than 4 coin carried; excess normally costs load or needs storage.'):good(`${number(s.resources?.coin)} carried coin.`);number(s.resources?.stress)>=number(s.resources?.stressMax)&&warn('Stress track is full; resolve trauma.');['playbook','insight','prowess','resolve'].forEach(k=>{const max=k==='playbook'?8:6;if(number(s.xp?.[k])>=max)warn(`${k} XP track is full.`)});number(s.crew?.crewXp)>=10&&warn('Crew XP track is full.');break}case'dnd-5e-5.5e':{const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),xp=number(s.profile?.xp),next=l>=20?Infinity:DND_XP[l];xp>=next&&warn(`Enough XP for level ${l+1}.`);good(`Level ${l}; proficiency bonus ${2+Math.floor(Math.max(0,l-1)/4)}.`);const coins=s.coins||{},cp=number(coins.cp)+10*number(coins.sp)+50*number(coins.ep)+100*number(coins.gp)+1000*number(coins.pp);good(`${(cp/100).toFixed(2)} gp equivalent.`);break}}
 a.audit.lastRun=now();const ul=$('hyperMathAudit');if(ul)ul.innerHTML=items.map(x=>`<li class="${x.kind}">${html(x.text)}</li>`).join('');return items}

function currentRollContract(){const s=stateRef();switch(CFG.id){case'fate-core':{const skill=s.skills?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.skill);return{kind:'fate_action',dice:'4dF',skill:s.roll?.skill,skill_rating:number(skill?.rating),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),invokes:number(s.roll?.invokeCount),opposition:number(s.roll?.opposition),action:s.roll?.action}}case'gurps-4e':return{kind:'gurps_success_roll',dice:'3d6',target:number(s.combat?.attackSkill)+number(s.combat?.attackModifier),roll_under:true};case'coc-7e':return{kind:'coc_percentile',dice:'d100',skill:s.roll?.skill,target:number(s.roll?.target),difficulty:s.roll?.difficulty,bonus_penalty:number(s.roll?.bonusPenalty)};case'daggerheart':return{kind:'daggerheart_action',dice:'2d12_hope_fear',trait:s.roll?.trait,trait_modifier:number(s.traits?.[s.roll?.trait]),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),advantage:number(s.roll?.advantage),difficulty:number(s.roll?.difficulty),experience_index:number(s.roll?.experienceIndex)};case'pathfinder-2e-remastered':return{kind:'pf2e_check',dice:'d20',type:s.roll?.type,key:s.roll?.key,dc:number(s.roll?.dc),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),map:number(s.roll?.map),agile:!!s.roll?.agile};case'pbta-adapter':{const d6':''}`,trait:s.roll?.trait,modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier)-(s.roll?.woundPenalty?number(s.resources?.wounds):0),target:number(s.roll?.target),acing:true};case'blades-in-the-dark':{const function resolveExternalRoll(payload={}){const c=currentRollContract(),s=stateRef();let out={system:CFG.id,kind:c.kind,received:copy(payload),at:now()};if(c.kind==='fate_action'){const dice=Array.isArray(payload.dice)?payload.dice.reduce((n,x)=>n+number(x),0):number(payload.diceTotal);const total=dice+c.skill_rating+c.modifier+c.invokes*2,shifts=total-c.opposition;out={...out,total,shifts,outcome:shifts<0?'Fail':shifts===0?'Tie':shifts<3?'Succeed':'Succeed with style'}}else if(c.kind==='gurps_success_roll'){const roll=number(payload.total),margin=c.target-roll;out={...out,total:roll,target:c.target,margin,outcome:roll<=c.target?'Success':'Failure'}}else if(c.kind==='coc_percentile'){const roll=number(payload.total),target=c.target,hard=Math.floor(target/2),extreme=Math.floor(target/5);let level=roll===1?'Critical':roll<=extreme?'Extreme':roll<=hard?'Hard':roll<=target?'Regular':roll>=96?'Fumble':'Failure';const needed=c.difficulty==='Extreme'?'Extreme':c.difficulty==='Hard'?'Hard':'Regular',rank={Failure:0,Fumble:0,Regular:1,Hard:2,Extreme:3,Critical:4};out={...out,total:roll,target,success:rank[level]>=rank[needed],level,needed}}else if(c.kind==='daggerheart_action'){const hope=number(payload.hope),fear=number(payload.fear),exp=c.experience_index>=0?number(s.experiences?.[c.experience_index]?.value):0,total=hope+fear+c.trait_modifier+c.modifier+exp+number(payload.advantageTotal),critical=hope===fear,duality=hope>=fear?'Hope':'Fear';out={...out,hope,fear,total,critical,duality,success:critical||total>=c.difficulty}}else if(c.kind==='pf2e_check'){const die=number(payload.die),baseMod=number(payload.totalModifier??c.modifier),total=die+baseMod,delta=total-c.dc;let degree=delta>=10?3:delta>=0?2:delta<=-10?0:1;if(die===20)degree=Math.min(3,degree+1);if(die===1)degree=Math.max(0,degree-1);out={...out,die,total,dc:c.dc,degree:['Critical Failure','Failure','Success','Critical Success'][degree]}}else if(c.kind==='pbta_move'){const dice=number(payload.total),total=dice+c.modifier,a=c.bands;let band=total>=number(a.advancedMin)?a.advancedLabel:total>=number(a.highMin)?a.hitLabel:total<=number(a.lowMax)?a.missLabel:a.mixedLabel;out={...out,dice,total,band}}else if(c.kind==='swade_trait'){const trait=number(payload.traitTotal),wild=payload.wildTotal===undefined?null:number(payload.wildTotal),best=wild===null?trait:Math.max(trait,wild),total=best+c.modifier,raises=total>=c.target?Math.floor((total-c.target)/4):0;out={...out,trait,wild,total,target:c.target,success:total>=c.target,raises}}else if(c.kind==='bitd_action'){const dice=Array.isArray(payload.dice)?payload.dice.map(number):[],sorted=[...dice].sort((a,b)=>b-a),highest=sorted[0]||0,critical=sorted.filter(x=>x===6).length>=2&&!c.zero_dice;out={...out,dice,highest,critical,outcome:critical?'Critical':highest===6?'Full success':highest>=4?'Partial success':'Bad outcome'}}else if(c.kind==='dnd_d20_test'){const die=number(payload.die),modifier=number(payload.modifier),total=die+modifier;out={...out,die,modifier,total,dc:payload.dc===undefined?null:number(payload.dc),success:payload.dc===undefined?null:total>=number(payload.dc)}}auto().portal.lastResult=out;auto().portal.lastRequest=c;schedule();renderPortal();window.parent!==window&&window.parent.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_ROLL_RESOLVED',payload:out},'*');return out}

let libraryCache=null;
function textFromObject(o){const keys=['description','desc','text','effect','rules','summary','trigger','on_hit','success','failure','cost','range','damage','duration','requirements','prerequisites','notes'];let parts=[];for(const k of keys){const v=o?.[k];if(typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())parts.push(v.trim());else if(Array.isArray(v)&&v.length&&v.every(x=>typeof x==='string'))parts.push(v.join('; '))}return parts.join('\n').slice(0,5000)}
function detectType(title,text=''){const s=(title+' '+text).toLowerCase();if(/spell|cantrip|ritual|domain card/.test(s))return'Spell / power';if(/attack|weapon|strike|damage/.test(s))return'Attack';if(/move|action/.test(s))return'Move / action';if(/feat|edge|stunt|feature|ability|advantage|talent|perk/.test(s))return'Feature / ability';if(/skill|trait|attribute/.test(s))return'Skill / trait';return'Rule / option'}
function buildLibrary(){if(libraryCache)return libraryCache;const items=[],seen=new Set();const add=(title,text,source='Character sheet')=>{title=String(title||'').trim();text=String(text||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(!title||title.length>180||(!text&&source!=='Character state'))return;const key=(title+'|'+text.slice(0,180)).toLowerCase();if(seen.has(key))return;seen.add(key);items.push({title,text:text||'No description has been entered yet.',source,type:detectType(title,text)})};
 const selectors=['.attack-card','.spell-card','.feature-card','.feat-card','.stunt-card','.power-card','.move-card','.ability-card','.edge-card','[data-card-index]','.repeat-row'];for(const sel of selectors)$$(sel).forEach(el=>{const title=el.querySelector('h3,h4,b,label,input')?.textContent?.trim()||el.querySelector('input')?.value||'';const text=el.innerText||el.textContent||'';if(text.length>15)add(title,text,'Current character')});
 const s=sheetState();for(const key of ['attacks','weapons','spells','features','feats','stunts','powers','moves','abilities','edges','advantages','skills','traits','domainCards','inventory'])if(Array.isArray(s[key]))s[key].forEach(o=>{if(o&&typeof o==='object')add(o.name||o.title||o.label||key,textFromObject(o)||JSON.stringify(o,null,2).slice(0,3000),'Character state')});
 try{const raw=$('#rulesReference')?.textContent;if(raw){const data=JSON.parse(raw),visited=new WeakSet();let count=0;const walk=(v,depth=0)=>{if(!v||typeof v!=='object'||depth>12||count>2200||visited.has(v))return;visited.add(v);if(!Array.isArray(v)){const title=v.name||v.title||v.label||v.heading;const text=textFromObject(v);if(title&&text){add(title,text,'Embedded rules reference');count++}}if(Array.isArray(v))for(const x of v)walk(x,depth+1);else for(const x of Object.values(v))walk(x,depth+1)};walk(data)}}catch(_){ }
 libraryCache=items.slice(0,2600);return libraryCache}

'use strict';
function initTrueMenu(){
  const bubble=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubble');
  const toggle=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubbleToggle');
  const panel=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubblePanel');
  if(!bubble||!toggle||!panel||bubble.dataset.trueMenuReady==='1')return;
  bubble.dataset.trueMenuReady='1';
  toggle.title='Open navigation and sheet design menu. Drag the button to move it.';
  panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  panel.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');

  const backdrop=document.createElement('button');
  backdrop.type='button';
  backdrop.className='cs-menu-backdrop';
  backdrop.setAttribute('aria-label','Close menu');
  bubble.insertBefore(backdrop,panel);

  const title=panel.querySelector('.cs-panel-title');
  const header=document.createElement('div');
  header.className='cs-menu-header';
  const close=document.createElement('button');
  close.type='button';
  close.className='cs-menu-close';
  close.setAttribute('aria-label','Close menu');
  close.textContent='×';
  panel.insertBefore(header,panel.firstChild);
  if(title)header.appendChild(title);
  header.appendChild(close);

  const navGroup=document.createElement('div');
  navGroup.className='cs-menu-nav';
  navGroup.innerHTML='<span class="cs-label">Quick navigation</span><div class="cs-menu-link-grid"></div>';
  header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',navGroup);
  const grid=navGroup.querySelector('.cs-menu-link-grid');
  const navLinks=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav.nav a[href^="#"]')];
  const targets=[{label:'Top of Sheet',target:'__top'},...navLinks.map(a=>({label:(a.textContent||'Section').trim(),target:a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)})),{label:'Bottom of Sheet',target:'__bottom'}];
  const seen=new Set();
  targets.forEach(item=>{
    const key=item.target+'|'+item.label;
    if(seen.has(key))return;
    seen.add(key);
    const button=document.createElement('button');
    button.type='button';
    button.className='cs-menu-link';
    button.textContent=item.label;
    button.dataset.jumpTarget=item.target;
    grid.appendChild(button);
  });

  function closeMenu(returnFocus=false){
    bubble.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    if(returnFocus)toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  close.addEventListener('click',()=>closeMenu(true));
  backdrop.addEventListener('click',()=>closeMenu(true));
  grid.addEventListener('click',event=>{
    const button=event.target.closest('.cs-menu-link');
    if(!button)return;
    const target=button.dataset.jumpTarget;
    if(target==='__top')window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    else if(target==='__bottom')window.scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'});
    else document.getElementById(target)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
    closeMenu(false);
  });

  let wasOpen=false;
  function syncOpenState(){
    const open=bubble.classList.contains('open');
    document.body.classList.toggle('cs-menu-open',open);
    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!open));
    if(open!==wasOpen){
      if(open)requestAnimationFrame(()=>close.focus({preventScroll:true}));
      else if(panel.contains(document.activeElement))toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});
      wasOpen=open;
    }
  }
  new MutationObserver(syncOpenState).observe(bubble,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  syncOpenState();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initTrueMenu,{once:true});else initTrueMenu();
})();

function cleanKey(s){return String(s||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'_').replace(/^_|_$/g,'')}

function status(msg,type=''){const n=$('rheStatus');if(!n)return;n.textContent=msg;n.className='rhe-status '+(type==='good'?'rhe-good':type==='danger'?'rhe-danger':'');}

function detectFields(){const out=[];document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach((el,i)=>{if(el.closest('#rules-homebrew-engine')||['button','file','hidden','checkbox','radio'].includes(el.type))return;let label='';if(el.id){const l=document.querySelector(`label[for="${CSS.escape(el.id)}"]`);if(l)label=l.textContent.trim()}if(!label){const l=el.closest('label');if(l)label=l.textContent.replace(el.value||'','').trim()}if(!label)label=el.getAttribute('aria-label')||el.placeholder||el.name||el.id||`Field ${i+1}`;out.push({token:el.id?'#'+el.id:'@'+i,label:label.slice(0,90),el})});return out}
function tokenize(expr){const s=String(expr||'').trim();if(!s)return[];const re=/\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d*\.\d+|\d+|[()+\-*/%,])\s*/gy;let m,pos=0,t=[];while((m=re.exec(s))){if(m.index!==pos)throw Error('Unexpected token near '+s.slice(pos,pos+12));t.push(m[1]);pos=re.lastIndex}if(pos!==s.length)throw Error('Unexpected token near '+s.slice(pos,pos+12));return t}
function evalExpr(expr,ctx){const t=tokenize(expr);let p=0;const peek=()=>t[p],take=()=>t[p++];function primary(){let x=take();if(x===undefined)throw Error('Incomplete formula');if(x==='('){let v=add();if(take()!==')')throw Error('Missing )');return v}if(x==='+'||x==='-'){let v=primary();return x==='-'?-v:v}if(/^\d/.test(x))return Number(x);if(/^[A-Za-z_]/.test(x)){if(peek()==='('){take();let a=[];if(peek()!==')'){while(true){a.push(add());if(peek()===','){take();continue}break}}if(take()!==')')throw Error('Missing ) after function');const f={min:Math.min,max:Math.max,floor:Math.floor,ceil:Math.ceil,round:Math.round,abs:Math.abs}[x.toLowerCase()];if(!f)throw Error('Unknown function '+x);return f(...a)}return Number(ctx[cleanKey(x)]??0)}throw Error('Unexpected '+x)}function mul(){let v=primary();while(['*','/','%'].includes(peek())){let o=take(),r=primary();v=o==='*'?v*r:o==='/'?(r===0?0:v/r):v%r}return v}function add(){let v=mul();while(['+','-'].includes(peek())){let o=take(),r=mul();v=o==='+'?v+r:v-r}return v}const v=add();if(p<t.length)throw Error('Unexpected '+peek());return Number.isFinite(v)?v:0}
function calculate(){const ctx={},detail={};state.bases.forEach(b=>{const k=cleanKey(b.key||b.label);if(!k)return;const v=Number(b.value)||0;ctx[k]=v;detail[k]={label:b.label||k,base:v,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],final:v}});const active=state.selected.filter(o=>o.active!==false);for(const o of active){for(const ef of o.effects||[]){const k=cleanKey(ef.target);if(!k)continue;if(!detail[k])detail[k]={label:ef.target||k,base:Number(ctx[k])||0,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],final:Number(ctx[k])||0};let v=0;try{v=evalExpr(ef.value,ctx)}catch(err){v=0;ef.error=err.message}const note={value:v,from:o.name,formula:ef.value};({add:'adds',multiply:'mults',set:'sets',min:'mins',max:'maxs'}[ef.op]&&detail[k][{add:'adds',multiply:'mults',set:'sets',min:'mins',max:'maxs'}[ef.op]].push(note))}}
for(const [k,d] of Object.entries(detail)){let v=d.base;d.adds.forEach(x=>v+=x.value);d.mults.forEach(x=>v*=x.value);d.sets.forEach(x=>v=x.value);d.mins.forEach(x=>v=Math.max(v,x.value));d.maxs.forEach(x=>v=Math.min(v,x.value));d.final=Number.isFinite(v)?v:0;ctx[k]=d.final}
// derived formulas: multiple passes for dependencies
for(let pass=0;pass<Math.max(2,state.formulas.length+1);pass++)for(const f of state.formulas){const k=cleanKey(f.key||f.label);if(!k)continue;try{const v=evalExpr(f.formula,ctx);ctx[k]=v;detail[k]={label:f.label||k,base:null,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],formula:f.formula,final:v}}catch(err){detail[k]={label:f.label||k,formula:f.formula,error:err.message,final:0};ctx[k]=0}}
return{ctx,detail}}
function renderCatalog(){const q=$('rheSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase(),cat=$('rheCategory').value,kind=$('rheKind').value;let a=CATALOG.filter(x=>(!cat||x.category===cat)&&(!kind||x.kind===kind)&&(!q||[x.name,x.category,x.source,x.summary,(x.tags||[]).join(' ')].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)));const cap=$('rheShowAll').dataset.all==='1'?a.length:250;a=a.slice(0,cap);$('rheCatalog').innerHTML=a.length?a.map(x=>`<div class="rhe-row"><div><b>${esc(x.name)}</b><small>${esc(x.summary||'')}</small></div><div><span class="rhe-pill">${esc(x.category)}</span><span class="rhe-pill">${esc(x.kind)}</span></div><div><small>${esc(x.source||'')}</small>${x.url?`<a class="rhe-source-link" href="${esc(x.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Official/live source</a>`:''}</div><button type="button" data-rhe-add="${esc(x.id)}">Add</button></div>`).join(''):`<div class="rhe-empty">No matching catalog entries.</div>`;}

function flatten(o,p='',out={}){if(o==null)return out;if(Array.isArray(o)){o.forEach((v,i)=>flatten(v,p?`${p}.${i}`:String(i),out));return out}if(typeof o==='object'){Object.entries(o).forEach(([k,v])=>flatten(v,p?`${p}.${k}`:k,out));return out}out[norm(p)]=o;return out}
function pick(flat,...keys){for(const k of keys){const nk=norm(k);if(flat[nk]!=null&&flat[nk]!=='')return flat[nk];for(const [p,v] of Object.entries(flat))if((p===nk||p.endsWith(' '+nk))&&v!=null&&v!=='')return v}return''}
function listFrom(v){if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:(x?.name||x?.id||JSON.stringify(x)));return String(v||'').split(/\r?\n|\s*[;,|]\s*/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean)}
function score(a,b){a=norm(a);b=norm(b);if(!a||!b)return 0;if(a===b)return 100;if(a.includes(b)||b.includes(a))return 76;const A=new Set(a.split(' ')),B=new Set(b.split(' '));let i=0;A.forEach(x=>B.has(x)&&i++);return 50*(2*i/(A.size+B.size||1))}
function catalog(sys,cat){const d=LEGAL[sys]||{}, n=norm(cat),out=[];Object.entries(d).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(norm(k)===n||norm(k).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(k)))out.push(...v)});const c=CURATED[sys]||{};Object.entries(c).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(norm(k)===n||norm(k).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(k)))out.push(...v)});return uniq(out)}
function bestLegal(sys,cat,wanted,fallback,report,reason=''){const options=catalog(sys,cat);if(!options.length){const val=wanted||fallback||'';if(val)report.review.push(`${cat}: “${val}” could not be fully catalog-validated; retained for DM/GM/MOL review.`);return val}let best='',bestScore=-1;for(const o of options){const s=score(wanted,o);if(s>bestScore){best=o;bestScore=s}}if(wanted&&bestScore>=74)return best;const chosen=fallback&&options.find(o=>norm(o)===norm(fallback))||best||options[0];if(wanted&&norm(wanted)!==norm(chosen))report.replacements.push({category:cat,from:wanted,to:chosen,reason:reason||'No exact legal target-system match.'});return chosen}

function abilityNumber(v){if(v&&typeof v==='object')return num(v.base)+num(v.origin)+num(v.other);return num(v)}
function canonicalBase(){return{sourceSystem:'unknown',name:'',player:'',campaign:'',concept:'',pronouns:'',gender:'',ancestry:'',heritage:'',background:'',occupation:'',classes:[],level:1,abilities:{},skills:[],feats:[],spells:[],attacks:[],equipment:[],resources:[],languages:[],proficiencies:[],notes:{appearance:'',personality:'',backstory:'',relationships:'',session:''},hp:0,ac:0,speed:0,raw:null,sourceText:''}}
function canonicalDnd(obj){const s=obj.character||obj,c=canonicalBase(),p=s.profile||{};c.sourceSystem='dnd';c.name=p.characterName||p.name||'';c.player=p.playerName||p.player||'';c.campaign=p.campaignName||p.campaign||'';c.pronouns=p.pronouns==='Write in…'?p.pronounsWriteIn:p.pronouns;c.gender=p.genderIdentity==='Write in…'?p.genderWriteIn:p.genderIdentity;c.ancestry=p.race==='__writein__'?p.raceWriteIn:p.race;c.heritage=p.raceOption==='__writein__'?p.raceOptionWriteIn:p.raceOption;c.background=p.background==='__writein__'?p.backgroundWriteIn:p.background;c.classes=arr(s.classes).map(x=>({name:x.name||'',level:num(x.level,1),subclass:x.subclass||''})).filter(x=>x.name);c.level=c.classes.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.level,0)||1;Object.entries(s.abilities||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>c.abilities[k]=abilityNumber(v));c.skills=Object.entries(s.skills||{}).map(([name,v])=>({name,value:num(v.rank),rank:num(v.rank),ability:v.ability||'',misc:num(v.misc)}));c.attacks=arr(s.attacks).map(x=>({...x,name:x.name||'Attack'}));c.spells=arr(s.spells).map(x=>({name:title(x.name||x.id||''),...x})).filter(x=>x.name);c.equipment=arr(s.items).map(x=>({...x,name:x.name||'Item'}));c.resources=arr(s.customResources);c.languages=listFrom(s.languages);c.proficiencies=listFrom(s.proficiencies);c.hp=num(s.hp?.current||s.hp?.max);c.ac=num(s.combat?.acOverride||s.combat?.armorBase)+num(s.combat?.shieldBonus)+num(s.combat?.miscAC);c.speed=30+num(s.combat?.speedMisc);c.notes={...c.notes,...(s.notes||{})};const explicit=[];arr(s.levelHistory).forEach(h=>arr(h.features).forEach(f=>{if(/feat\s*:/i.test(f)||/ability score improvement/i.test(f))explicit.push(String(f))}));const origin=s.jasperGuidance?.sourceCharacter?.background?.origin_feat?.name;if(origin)explicit.push(origin);c.feats=uniq(explicit);c.raw=s;return c}
function canonicalNative(obj,sys){const s=obj.character||obj,c=canonicalBase(),p=s.profile||{};c.sourceSystem=sys;c.name=p.name||p.characterName||'';c.player=p.player||p.playerName||'';c.campaign=p.campaign||p.campaignName||'';c.concept=p.concept||'';c.pronouns=p.pronouns||'';c.ancestry=p.ancestry||p.race||'';c.heritage=p.heritage||p.raceOption||'';c.background=p.background||'';c.occupation=p.occupation||'';c.level=num(p.level||s.level,1);c.raw=s;
 if(sys==='pathfinder'){Object.entries(s.attributes||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>c.abilities[k.toUpperCase()]=num(v));c.classes=p.className?[{name:p.className,level:c.level,subclass:''}]:[];c.skills=Object.entries(s.skills||{}).map(([name,v])=>({name,rank:num(v.rank),value:num(v.rank),misc:num(v.misc)}));c.feats=arr(s.feats);c.spells=arr(s.spells);c.attacks=arr(s.attacks);c.equipment=arr(s.inventory);c.hp=num(s.hp?.current);c.speed=num(p.speed)}
 else if(sys==='daggerheart'){c.classes=p.className?[{name:p.className,level:c.level,subclass:p.subclass||''}]:[];c.ancestry=p.ancestry;c.background=p.community;Object.assign(c.abilities,s.traits||{});c.skills=arr(s.experiences).map(x=>({name:x.name||'Experience',value:num(x.modifier)}));c.feats=[...arr(s.features),...arr(s.cards)];c.attacks=arr(s.weapons);c.equipment=arr(s.inventory);c.hp=num(s.resources?.hpMax)-num(s.resources?.hpMarked)}
 else if(sys==='fate'){c.concept=p.concept;c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.rating)}));c.feats=arr(s.stunts);c.notes.personality=Object.values(s.aspects||{}).filter(Boolean).join('\n');}
 else if(sys==='gurps'){Object.assign(c.abilities,s.attributes||{});c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.level||x.points),...x}));c.feats=[...arr(s.advantages),...arr(s.disadvantages),...arr(s.quirks)];c.attacks=arr(s.attacks);c.equipment=arr(s.equipment);c.hp=num(s.combat?.hpCurrent)}
 else if(sys==='coc'){Object.assign(c.abilities,s.characteristics||{});c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.value)}));c.attacks=arr(s.weapons);c.spells=arr(s.spells);c.equipment=arr(s.tomes);c.hp=num(s.resources?.hpCurrent);c.background=p.occupation}
 else if(sys==='swade'){Object.assign(c.abilities,s.attributes||{});c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.die),...x}));c.feats=[...arr(s.edges),...arr(s.hindrances)];c.spells=arr(s.powers);c.attacks=arr(s.weapons);c.equipment=arr(s.gear);c.ancestry=p.ancestry;c.level=Math.max(1,arr(s.advances).length+1)}
 else if(sys==='blades'){c.classes=p.playbook?[{name:p.playbook,level:1,subclass:''}]:[];c.ancestry=p.heritage;c.background=p.background;c.skills=arr(s.actions).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.rating),rank:num(x.rating)}));c.feats=arr(s.abilities);c.equipment=arr(s.items);c.notes.personality=[p.vice,p.look].filter(Boolean).join('\n')}
 else if(sys==='pbta'){c.classes=p.playbook?[{name:p.playbook,level:1,subclass:''}]:[];c.skills=arr(s.stats).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.value)}));c.feats=arr(s.moves);c.equipment=arr(s.gear);c.concept=p.concept}
 return c}
function detectSystem(obj){const hint=norm(obj?.system_id||obj?.system||obj?.schema||obj?.metadata?.system||'');if(hint.includes('dnd'))return'dnd';if(hint.includes('pathfinder'))return'pathfinder';if(hint.includes('dagger'))return'daggerheart';if(hint.includes('cthulhu')||hint==='coc')return'coc';if(hint.includes('gurps'))return'gurps';if(hint.includes('savage')||hint.includes('swade'))return'swade';if(hint.includes('blade'))return'blades';if(hint.includes('pbta')||hint.includes('powered'))return'pbta';if(hint.includes('fate'))return'fate';const s=obj?.character||obj;if(s?.profile?.edition&&s?.abilities&&s?.classes)return'dnd';if(s?.profile?.className&&s?.attributes&&s?.heroPoints!=null)return'pathfinder';if(s?.traits&&s?.thresholds&&s?.cards)return'daggerheart';if(s?.characteristics&&s?.resources?.sanCurrent!=null)return'coc';if(s?.budget&&s?.adjustments&&s?.advantages)return'gurps';if(s?.edges&&s?.hindrances&&s?.resources?.bennies!=null)return'swade';if(s?.actions&&s?.crew&&s?.score)return'blades';if(s?.adapter&&s?.moves&&s?.conversation)return'pbta';if(s?.aspects&&s?.fatePoints!=null)return'fate';return'unknown'}
function canonicalJson(obj){const sys=detectSystem(obj);return sys==='dnd'?canonicalDnd(obj):sys!=='unknown'?canonicalNative(obj,sys):canonicalFromFlat(obj)}
function keyMatch(k,names){const n=norm(k);return names.some(x=>n===norm(x))}
function collectValues(obj,names,out=[]){if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object')return out;const walk=(v,k='')=>{if(k&&keyMatch(k,names)){out.push(v);return}if(Array.isArray(v))v.forEach(x=>walk(x));else if(v&&typeof v==='object')Object.entries(v).forEach(([a,b])=>walk(b,a))};walk(obj);return out}
function recordList(v){if(v==null||v==='')return[];if(Array.isArray(v))return v.flatMap(recordList);if(typeof v==='object'){if(v.name||v.id||v.title||v.className||v.playbook)return[v];return Object.entries(v).flatMap(([k,x])=>{if(x&&typeof x==='object')return[{name:x.name||x.id||x.title||k,...x}];return[{name:k,value:x}]})}return listFrom(v).map(name=>({name}))}
function collectRecords(obj,names){const out=collectValues(obj,names).flatMap(recordList),seen=new Set();return out.filter(x=>{const k=norm(x?.name||x?.id||x?.title||JSON.stringify(x));if(!k||seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true})}
function sectionText(t,labels){const wanted=labels.map(norm),lines=String(t||'').replace(/\u0000/g,'').split(/\r?\n/);let active=false,out=[];for(const raw of lines){const line=raw.trim();if(!line)continue;const h=line.match(/^#{0,3}\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 /&'’_-]{1,55})\s*:?[ \t]*$/);if(h){const n=norm(h[1]),hit=wanted.some(x=>n===x||n.includes(x)||x.includes(n));if(hit){active=true;continue}if(active)break}if(active)out.push(line.replace(/^[-*•]\s*/,''))}return out.join('\n')}
function fieldText(flat,t,keys){const v=pick(flat,...keys);return v!==''&&v!=null?text(v):sectionText(t,keys)}
function skillRecords(v){return recordList(v).map(x=>{if(typeof x!=='object')return{name:String(x)};const raw=x.name||'';const m=String(raw).match(/^(.*?)(?:\s*(?:[:=]|\+)\s*(-?\d+))\s*$/);return m&&m[2]!=null?{...x,name:m[1].trim(),value:num(m[2]),rank:num(m[2])}:x})}
function canonicalFromFlat(objOrText){const c=canonicalBase(),isText=typeof objOrText==='string',t=isText?objOrText:'',src=isText?null:objOrText;let flat=isText?parseTextFlat(t):flatten(objOrText);c.name=String(pick(flat,'character name','charactername','investigator name','scoundrel name','name'));c.player=String(pick(flat,'player name','player'));c.campaign=String(pick(flat,'campaign name','campaign','setting'));c.pronouns=String(pick(flat,'pronouns'));c.gender=String(pick(flat,'gender identity','gender'));c.ancestry=String(pick(flat,'race species','race','species','ancestry','heritage ancestry'));c.heritage=String(pick(flat,'subrace','heritage','versatile heritage'));c.background=String(pick(flat,'background','occupation','community'));c.occupation=String(pick(flat,'occupation'));c.concept=String(pick(flat,'concept','high concept','archetype','look'));const lvl=num(pick(flat,'level','character level','tier'),1),classRows=src?collectRecords(src,['classes','class','className','playbook']):[];if(classRows.length)c.classes=classRows.map(x=>({name:String(x.name||x.className||x.playbook||''),level:num(x.level,lvl),subclass:String(x.subclass||x.specialization||'')})).filter(x=>x.name);else{const cls=fieldText(flat,t,['class','class name','classes','playbook']);if(cls)c.classes=parseClasses(cls,lvl)}c.level=c.classes.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.level,0)||lvl;const aliases={Strength:['strength','str'],Dexterity:['dexterity','dex'],Constitution:['constitution','con'],Intelligence:['intelligence','int','iq'],Wisdom:['wisdom','wis'],Charisma:['charisma','cha'],ST:['st'],DX:['dx'],IQ:['iq'],HT:['ht'],POW:['pow'],EDU:['edu'],SIZ:['siz'],APP:['app']};Object.entries(aliases).forEach(([k,ks])=>{for(const x of ks){const v=pick(flat,x);if(v!==''&&v!=null){c.abilities[k]=num(v);break}}});const skillSource=src?collectRecords(src,['skills','skill list','actions','experiences']):[];c.skills=skillSource.length?skillRecords(skillSource):skillRecords(fieldText(flat,t,['skills','skill proficiencies','actions','experiences']));c.feats=src?collectRecords(src,['feats','features','class features','special abilities','stunts','advantages','edges','moves','domain cards']):[];if(!c.feats.length)c.feats=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['feats','features','special abilities','stunts','advantages','edges','moves']));c.spells=src?collectRecords(src,['spells','spell list','powers','rituals']):[];if(!c.spells.length)c.spells=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['spells','spell list','powers','rituals']));c.attacks=src?collectRecords(src,['attacks','weapons','combat actions']):[];if(!c.attacks.length)c.attacks=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['attacks','weapons','combat actions']));c.equipment=src?collectRecords(src,['equipment','items','inventory','gear']):[];if(!c.equipment.length)c.equipment=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['equipment','items','inventory','gear']));c.resources=src?collectRecords(src,['resources','resource trackers','pools']):[];if(!c.resources.length)c.resources=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['resources','resource trackers','pools']));const langValues=src?collectValues(src,['languages','language']):[];c.languages=uniq((langValues.length?langValues:[fieldText(flat,t,['languages','language'])]).flatMap(listFrom));const profValues=src?collectValues(src,['proficiencies','proficiency','trainings']):[];c.proficiencies=uniq((profValues.length?profValues:[fieldText(flat,t,['proficiencies','proficiency','trainings'])]).flatMap(listFrom));c.hp=num(pick(flat,'hit points','hp current','hp','health'));c.ac=num(pick(flat,'armor class','ac','defense'));c.speed=num(pick(flat,'speed','pace','move'));c.notes.appearance=fieldText(flat,t,['appearance','look']);c.notes.personality=fieldText(flat,t,['personality','traits','ideals bonds flaws']);c.notes.backstory=fieldText(flat,t,['backstory','history','background story']);c.notes.relationships=fieldText(flat,t,['relationships','bonds','connections','contacts']);c.sourceText=isText?t:JSON.stringify(objOrText,null,2);c.notes.session=isText?t.slice(0,30000):fieldText(flat,'',['session notes','notes','campaign notes'])||('Unmapped source data retained for review:\n'+c.sourceText.slice(0,30000));return c}
function parseClasses(v,defaultLevel=1){return String(v||'').split(/\s*[/,;|]\s*/).map(x=>{let m=x.match(/^(.*?)(?:\s+(\d+))?(?:\s*\((.*?)\))?$/);return{name:(m?.[1]||x).trim(),level:num(m?.[2],defaultLevel),subclass:(m?.[3]||'').trim()}}).filter(x=>x.name)}
function parseTextFlat(t){const out={};let section='';String(t||'').replace(/\u0000/g,'').split(/\r?\n/).forEach((raw,i)=>{const line=raw.trim();if(!line)return;if(/^#{0,3}\s*[A-Za-z][A-Za-z /&-]{2,40}:?$/.test(line)&&!/[0-9]/.test(line)){section=norm(line.replace(/[:#]/g,''));return}let m=line.match(/^([^:=]{2,45})\s*[:=]\s*(.+)$/);if(m)out[norm((section?section+' ':'')+m[1])]=m[2].trim();else{m=line.match(/^(STR|DEX|CON|INT|WIS|CHA|POW|EDU|SIZ|APP|ST|DX|IQ|HT)\s*[=: ]\s*(-?\d+)/i);if(m)out[norm(m[1])]=m[2];else out[`line ${i}`]=line}});return out}
async function docxText(file){if(!window.JSZip)throw Error('DOCX support library did not load.');const z=await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());const names=Object.keys(z.files).filter(n=>/^word\/(?:document|header\d+|footer\d+|comments\d*|footnotes|endnotes)\.xml$/i.test(n)).sort((a,b)=>a==='word/document.xml'?-1:b==='word/document.xml'?1:a.localeCompare(b));let out=[];for(const n of names){const f=z.file(n);if(!f)continue;const xml=await f.async('string');const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml,'application/xml');d.querySelectorAll('w\\:p,p').forEach(p=>{const t=Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('w\\:t,t')).map(x=>x.textContent).join('');if(t.trim())out.push(t.trim())})}if(!out.length)throw Error('No readable character text was found in the DOCX file.');return out.join('\n')}
function pdfStringDecode(s){let out='';for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(c==='\\'){let n=s[++i]||'';if(/[nrtbf]/.test(n))out+=({n:'\n',r:'\r',t:'\t',b:'\b',f:'\f'}[n]);else if(/[0-7]/.test(n)){let oct=n;for(let j=0;j<2&&/[0-7]/.test(s[i+1]||'');j++)oct+=s[++i];out+=String.fromCharCode(parseInt(oct,8))}else out+=n}else out+=c}return out}
function pdfHexDecode(h){const b=[];for(let i=0;i<h.length;i+=2)b.push(parseInt(h.slice(i,i+2).padEnd(2,'0'),16));if(b[0]===0xFE&&b[1]===0xFF){let out='';for(let i=2;i+1<b.length;i+=2)out+=String.fromCharCode((b[i]<<8)|b[i+1]);return out}try{return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(new Uint8Array(b))}catch(_){return String.fromCharCode(...b)}}
async function inflatePdf(data){try{const ds=new DecompressionStream('deflate');return new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([data]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).arrayBuffer())}catch(_){return null}}
function bytesToLatin(b){let out='',step=0x8000;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i+=step)out+=String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i,Math.min(b.length,i+step)));return out}
function extractPdfStrings(s){let out=[];const lit=/\((?:\\.|[^\\)])*\)\s*(?:Tj|'|")/gs;for(const m of s.matchAll(lit))out.push(pdfStringDecode(m[0].slice(1,m[0].lastIndexOf(')'))));for(const m of s.matchAll(/<([0-9A-Fa-f]+)>\s*(?:Tj|'|")/g))out.push(pdfHexDecode(m[1]));const arrays=/\[((?:.|\n)*?)\]\s*TJ/gs;for(const m of s.matchAll(arrays)){let line=[];for(const x of m[1].matchAll(/\((?:\\.|[^\\)])*\)|<([0-9A-Fa-f]+)>/g)){if(x[0][0]==='(')line.push(pdfStringDecode(x[0].slice(1,-1)));else line.push(pdfHexDecode(x[1]))}out.push(line.join(''))}return out}
async function pdfText(file){const b=new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()),raw=bytesToLatin(b),out=[];for(const m of raw.matchAll(/\/(?:T|TU|TM|V)\s*(\((?:\\.|[^\\)])*\)|<([0-9A-Fa-f]+)>)/gs)){const token=m[1];out.push(token[0]==='('?pdfStringDecode(token.slice(1,-1)):pdfHexDecode(m[2]))}for(const sm of raw.matchAll(/<<(.*?)>>\s*stream\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\nendstream/gs)){let data=new Uint8Array([...sm[2]].map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)&255));if(/FlateDecode/.test(sm[1])){const d=await inflatePdf(data);if(d)data=d;else continue}out.push(...extractPdfStrings(bytesToLatin(data)))}const cleaned=uniq(out.map(x=>x.replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()).filter(x=>x.length>1));if(cleaned.length<3)throw Error('No usable text fields were found. This may be a scanned/image-only PDF; export it as JSON/TXT or run OCR first.');return cleaned.join('\n')}
async function readFile(file){const ext=(file.name.split('.').pop()||'').toLowerCase();if(ext==='json'||/json/.test(file.type)){const t=await file.text();return{kind:'json',data:JSON.parse(t),text:t}}if(ext==='txt'||/text\//.test(file.type)){const t=await file.text();return{kind:'text',data:t,text:t}}if(ext==='docx'){const t=await docxText(file);return{kind:'text',data:t,text:t}}if(ext==='pdf'||file.type==='application/pdf'){const t=await pdfText(file);return{kind:'text',data:t,text:t}}throw Error('Supported character imports: JSON, TXT, DOCX, and text/fillable PDF.')}
function totalAbility(c,name,...aliases){for(const k of [name,...aliases])if(c.abilities[k]!=null)return num(c.abilities[k]);return 10}
function abilityMod(score){return Math.floor((num(score)-10)/2)}
function noteConversion(s,c,report){const block=['Universal conversion source: '+c.sourceSystem,report.replacements.length?'Automatic legal replacements:\n'+report.replacements.map(x=>`• ${x.category}: ${x.from} → ${x.to} (${x.reason})`).join('\n'):'No automatic option replacements were required.',report.review.length?'Review required:\n'+report.review.map(x=>'• '+x).join('\n'):''].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');if(s.notes&&typeof s.notes==='object'){const k='sessionNotes' in s.notes?'sessionNotes':('session' in s.notes?'session':'campaign');s.notes[k]=[s.notes[k],block].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n')}else if(s.story)s.story.notes=[s.story.notes,block].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');else if(s.background&&typeof s.background==='object')s.background.traits=[s.background.traits,block].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');return s}
